title: Anthropic apologizes for invisible Claude Fable guardrails
raw_excerpt: Anthropic has apologized for stealthily throttling its new AI model, Claude Fable 5 , with hidden guardrails that undermine both researchers and rivals using it to develop competing systems. The company says it is reversing course and will be more transparent about when the restrictions kick in, even if that means Fable refuses more queries. Fable is the first widely available model in Anthropic's Mythos class of AI systems, a group the company has spent months warning are too dangerous for public release . summary: Anthropic 为其新模型 Claude Fable 5 中隐藏的隐形护栏道歉，这些护栏会暗中限制研究人员和竞争对手的使用。公司承诺将撤销该政策，并提高限制触发的透明度。Fable 5 是 Anthropic 的 Mythos 类 AI 系统的首个广泛可用模型，此前该公司曾警告此类系统过于危险不宜公开发布。

title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation
raw_excerpt: DiffusionGemma, a 26B Mixture of Experts model, uses text diffusion for faster text generation, offering up to 4x speed increase on GPUs by generating text blocks simultaneously. It targets speed-critical applications, providing advantages like low latency and bi-directional attention, and fits in high-end consumer GPUs when quantized. While it trades some quality for speed compared to standard models, it allows for efficient local inference and is optimized for NVIDIA hardware.
summary: 谷歌发布 DiffusionGemma，一个 26B 参数的混合专家模型，采用文本扩散技术实现比传统自回归模型快 4 倍的文本生成速度。该模型通过同时生成文本块来降低延迟，适合速度敏感型应用，量化后可在高端消费级 GPU 上运行，但质量略有牺牲。

title: Google DeepMind is worried about what happens when millions of agents start to interact
raw_excerpt: Google DeepMind is funding research into the potential dangers of situations where millions of different AI agents interact with each other online. According to Rohin Shah, who directs the company’s AGI safety and alignment research, the mass-market arrival of agents that can carry out tasks without human oversight and follow instructions given to them by other agents creates a whole new class of risk . In an effort to address this, Google DeepMind—which made agent-based tools a centerpiece of Google I/O last month —has teamed up with several other organizations to announce a $10 million funding pot for researchers to study the behavior of multi-agent systems and come up with ways to prevent unsafe scenarios. Joining Google DeepMind are Schmidt Sciences, a philanthropic foundation set up by Eric and Wendy Schmidt; ARIA, the UK government’s moonshot agency ; the Cooperative AI foundation, a UK-based nonprofit research outfit; and Google’s charitable arm, Google.org. I asked Shah and James Fox, who leads the Science of Trustworthy AI program at Schmidt Sciences, what they hope to achieve with that $10 million. It’s no small sum, but it’s dwarfed by the budgets commanded by Google DeepMind’s own research teams. summary: Google DeepMind 正资助研究数百万 AI 代理在线交互的潜在危险。其 AGI 安全与对齐研究负责人 Rohin Shah 指出，无需人工监督即可执行任务的代理大规模出现，创造了全新类别的风险。DeepMind 已联合多家机构宣布 1000 万美元基金，用于研究多代理系统的安全性。

title: Open Reproduction of DeepSeek-R1
summary: Hugging Face 发布 Open-R1 项目，旨在完全开源复现 DeepSeek-R1 模型。该项目提供完整的训练代码、数据和评估基准，使研究者和开发者能够从头训练具有类似推理能力的模型，推动开放科学和可复现性。

title: karpathy/autoresearch

title: Amazon’s data centers used 2.5 billion gallons of water last year
raw_excerpt: Just after Seattle enacted a one-year data center moratorium that some of Amazon's own employees pushed for, Amazon shared how much water its data centers use, reportedly for the first time. With concerns about water consumption and energy use a focus of new AI data center construction debates, Amazon says its global data center operations consumed 2.5 billion gallons of water in 2025 at a rate of 0.12 liters per kilowatt-hour of electricity, dropping by two percent from its 2024 total even as it expanded operations. summary: 亚马逊首次披露其全球数据中心用水量：2025 年消耗 25 亿加仑水，每千瓦时电力耗水 0.12 升，较 2024 年下降 2%。随着 AI 数据中心建设引发的水资源和能源消耗争议，这一数据为行业提供了重要参考，也凸显了科技巨头在环保方面的压力。
